$comment: The Cast's duplicate records and what staff did about them (docs/duplicates.md, decisions 310 to 312 and 314). Every load runs Rock's duplicate finder at its end, then writes each pair's decision. A pair names two Cast people in either order. Dates count back from the install day.

pairs.story: A connection card made the Thomas record after Tom moved. Nobody has merged them yet, so the Duplicate Finder lists Tom.
The first John Smith record, with Jon's home phone saved as a mobile. Jamal's merge request covers it.
The second John Smith record, with Jon's home phone saved as a work number. Jamal's merge request covers it.
Alisha set the two John Smith records aside from each other, since both belong in Jon's record. Rock shows the pair again if its score changes.
A different John Smith, with his own email, phone, and address. Alisha marked him Not a Duplicate of Jon.
The other John Smith is not the first of Jon's duplicate records either.
The other John Smith is not the second of Jon's duplicate records either.

mergeRequests.note: Jon Smith signed up for a small group as John, and I found three records for him. Same email and address on all three. Can someone merge them into Jon's?
mergeRequests.story: Jamal cannot merge people, so Rock turned his merge into a request. It waits in Merge Requests.

merges.story: Sarah's first record was Sarah Jones, from when she came with Ben. After she married Jim, she got a second record as Sarah Simmons in his family. Alisha merged the old Sarah Jones record into it. Rock kept the old record's alias, wrote a Merged line in Sarah's History, and saved Jones as her previous last name.
